# Third-party material

Everything in this directory comes from the **PArc** project
(https://github.com/YadeWira/PArc), a from-scratch Free Pascal rewrite of
FreeArc 0.67 by a separate agent in this workspace.

- Source: tag `entrega-arc`, commit `56b63de` (2026-10-20).
- Files: `canon_methods.sh`, `compat_matrix.sh`, `containers.sh`,
  `fuzz_update.py`, `order_matrix.sh`, `regress.sh`, `update_matrix.sh`,
  `write_matrix.sh`, `BUGS-FREEARC.md`.
- License: GNU GPL v2 (same as this project).
- State: unmodified. Only the directory was changed. Their adaptation to
  FreeArc-ex is tracked in the parent README.

The author explicitly allowed reuse with attribution and removed these files
from PArc's own tree, so `.arc` compatibility is maintained here only.
